title: A machine learning approach using endpoint adjudication committee labels for the identification of sepsis predictors at the emergency department.
summary: Machine learning applied to emergency-department data labeled by an endpoint adjudication committee identified sepsis predictors, including variables with added diagnostic value; the authors characterize the analysis as exploratory.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis applies the stated model to the paper’s computer science dataset and evaluates the reported outcome.
